title: Current partial closed-kernel implementation and rank-eight local jet scope
statement: The later1520 receiver record reports admissible cubic dimension12, acoustic-limit charge rank8, exactly the four-translation kernel, two binary-cubic charge polynomials and positive deflated acoustic Hessians in both charts. The completed kernel adds a positive beta*beta^T term over its acoustic denominator to the ordinary pseudoinverse capacity at the singular rays. This is a limiting ROC inequality, not a finite-background Hessian evaluation. These reported exact local identities do not complete the global duality/attainment or16-support proof.
